library(bio3d)

pdb <- read.pdb("3AGY")
ca <- pdb$atom[pdb$calpha, c("chain", "resno", "resid", "b")]

# Exact B-factor for the atom labeled in your screenshot
subset(ca, chain == "D" & resno == 637)

# Low and high reference points for the C-alpha atoms in this entry
quantile(ca$b, c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

# Look up the second spot by chain and residue number
View(ca)
